method: Native spokenUnits on all actual scene line.text. after_cold_open_units is a planning subtotal only, not official measured body. No actual audio or duration PASS. Range is arithmetic, not a TTS prediction or permission to alter pacing.

projects.scope: Current frozen Chinese source; not actual media readiness or source/native admission.
projects.decision: Planning only. Native narration body includes cold open and spoken CTA and must actually measure 720–840 seconds at natural pace. Formal 5s/21s bookends add 26 seconds. Do not pad, slow playback or stretch pauses to meet the target.
